full_prompt_en: This square expressionist painting presents a wide-eyed figure against a crowded, darkly coloured ground. Behind the head, overlapping marks in black, dark green, rusty orange, cream and turquoise form a tangled field of angular fragments and small drawn objects. At the upper right, a teal rocket with an orange circular detail rises beside a broad cream cloud of curling smoke, while small block-like structures and looping red lines fill the lower-right edge. The large head occupies most of the left and centre, outlined by ragged black strokes and a fringe of short orange-red spikes. Its bright yellow-orange face has oversized uneven cream eyes, small dark pupils, raised brows, a short dark nose and a slightly open mouth. An orange ear projects on the left, and a dark neck covering meets a yellow section of clothing at the bottom. The surface is rough and densely worked, with crosshatching, short dashes, scratch-like lines and uneven patches of pigment extending to the edges. Black outlines press against the bright facial areas rather than forming smooth, realistic shading. Orange and yellow marks flare through the dark background, while muted teal fragments provide cooler interruptions. Illumination is expressed through colour contrast: the face and cream smoke are brightest, with no single natural light source governing the surrounding marks. The overall composition combines exaggerated rounded features, compressed spacing and a restless painted surface in an agitated, high-contrast warm-and-dark palette.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现性绘画描绘一位睁大双眼的人物，背后是拥挤而偏暗的色彩底面。头部周围，黑、深绿、铁锈橙、奶油白和青绿色笔痕交叠，形成由棱角碎片和小型手绘物件组成的杂乱色域。右上角，一枚带橙色圆形细节的青色火箭紧邻大片卷曲的奶油白烟云向上升起；右下缘填满小块状结构与缠绕红线。硕大的头部占据左侧与中央大部分，外轮廓由参差黑笔和橙红色短刺状发缘围住。明亮黄橙面孔带夸张且大小不均的奶油色眼睛、小深瞳孔、挑起的眉、短小深鼻和微张的嘴。橙色耳朵从左侧伸出，下缘的深色颈部包覆与黄色衣物部分相接。画面表面粗粝且笔痕密集，交叉排线、短划、刮擦般线条和不均匀颜料块一直延伸至边缘。黑色轮廓紧贴明亮脸部，并不形成光滑写实的明暗。橙黄笔痕在暗背景中闪现，低调青色碎片带来冷色间隔。照明通过色彩反差表达：面孔与奶油白烟云最亮，周围笔痕不服从单一自然光源。整体以夸张的圆润五官、压缩空间与躁动绘画表面构成强烈暖暗对比，气氛不安而急促。
style_prompt_en: The painted surface is deliberately restless, mixing broad irregular colour patches with scratchy strokes, crosshatching and abrupt contour marks. Saturated orange, yellow and turquoise flare against black and deep green, while small cream highlights keep the dark areas from merging completely. Shapes overlap tightly and vary in scale, creating a dense field with little quiet space. Edges shift between blunt blocks and jagged hand-drawn marks; pigment appears uneven and layered. Brightness gathers in isolated areas rather than following consistent natural illumination. The overall visual effect is raw, energetic and high-contrast, driven by compressed spacing and fragmented marks.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画表面刻意保持躁动，将不规则宽色块、刮擦笔痕、交叉排线和突兀轮廓混合在一起。饱和橙、黄与青绿色在黑色和深绿底面上迸出，少量奶油白亮点又避免暗部完全粘连。形状彼此紧密叠压，尺度变化明显，形成几乎没有安静留白的密集区域。边缘在钝重色块与锯齿般手绘标记之间变化，颜料呈现不均匀的层叠感。亮度聚集在零散局部，而不服从一致的自然光源。整体视觉粗粝、有劲且反差强烈，主要由压缩的间距与碎裂笔触推动。
theme_en: An expressive painted portrait with a bright orange-yellow face and wide eyes fills a densely worked dark field.
theme_zh: 橙黄色面庞与睁大双眼构成表情鲜明的绘画肖像，周围是密集笔触的暗色底面。
name: 炽彩粗线外来者绘画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
